description: This file defines the CompatTabHoneycomb class, which implements a tab interface relying on API 11 features, wrapping around Android's ActionBar.Tab and managing tab interactions with fragments.

classes.name: CompatTabHoneycomb
classes.description: Implementation of a tab interface using API 11 ActionBar APIs, managing tab selection and fragment transactions.

methods.name: CompatTabHoneycomb
methods.description: Constructor initializing the tab with activity context and tag.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the text label of the tab.

methods.name: setIcon
methods.description: Sets the icon of the tab.

methods.name: setTabListener
methods.description: Assigns a callback listener for tab events.

methods.name: getTab
methods.description: Returns the underlying native tab object.

methods.name: getCallback
methods.description: Returns the assigned tab callback listener.

methods.name: onTabReselected
methods.description: Handles reselection of the tab, invoking callback.

methods.name: setFragment
methods.description: Associates a fragment with the tab.

methods.name: getFragment
methods.description: Retrieves the fragment associated with the tab.
